releases.title: v2.2.0 — Album Window, Synced Lyrics, Sidebar & Playback Engine
releases.body:
## ame v2.2.0

A major UI/UX and audio-pipeline upgrade bringing a maximized album window, synced split-pane lyrics, collapsible sidebar navigation, Explore & Library views, personalized recommendations, and low-latency InnerTube playback reliability — all still running purely locally in guest mode with zero logins.

> **Content & Source Notice:** `ame` does **not** host, store centrally, or redistribute any audio, artwork, or lyrics. It acts purely as a local client scraping publicly accessible internet sources (`ytmusicapi` / YouTube Music InnerTube, `yt-dlp`, `LRCLIB`) with bounded on-disk caching.

### New Features

#### Album Window (`w` / `m`) & Mini Player
- Auto-opens a full-bleed **Now Playing Album Window** on playback with high-resolution Sixel / TGP / Halfcell cover art (`artwork.py`, `foot` + Kitty + Ghostty compatible) and minimizes cleanly to the persistent mini player bar (`m` / `w` / `esc`).
- Live **Synced Lyrics** (`L`) via **LRCLIB** with automatic YouTube Music lyrics fallback (`lyrics.py`), open by default alongside the cover art and clickable to jump playback to any line.
- Interactive **Up Next** split panel (`O`), **NerdStats** stream telemetry (`codec`, `kbps`, `client`, `CACHE`, `gain dB`), and optional **dynamic album-art accent tinting** (`D`).

#### Sidebar, Explore, Library, Stats & Settings
- **Collapsible Navigation Sidebar (`b`)**: Shown automatically on wide terminals (`>= 94` cols) alongside a clean top bar and 1-row bottom **Graphic Equalizer** (`v`).
- **Home (`h` / `t`)**: *For You*, *Recently Played*, *Quick Picks*, and *Charts & Mixe

releases.title: v2.1.0 — self-updater, AI recs & animated TUI
releases.body:
## ame v2.1.0

A major release featuring integrated self-updating, personalized AI recommendations, dynamic live trending, YouTube Music-style related queue generation, music-themed animated loaders, and streamlined navigation.

### What's New

#### ⚡ Built-in Self-Updater
• **Command-Line Updates**: Update directly with `ame --update` or check for updates with `ame --update --check`.
• **In-App Keybinding**: Press `U` anywhere in the app to trigger an in-place update.
• **Silent Update Alerts**: Automatic non-intrusive notification toast informs you when an update is published on GitHub.
• **Reinstall Support**: Use `ame --update --force` to repair or clean-reinstall environment dependencies.

#### 🧠 AI Recommendations & Live Trending
• **Personalized Recommendations (`r`)**: Smart recommendation engine that generates dynamic music suggestions tailored to your saved favourites and playback history.
• **Live Trending Charts (`t`)**: Dynamically browse popular music with category cycling (`[` and `]`) across genres like *All Genres*, *Hip-Hop / Rap*, *Pop / Global Hits*, and more.
• **Instant Refresh (`u`)**: Fetch fresh trending and recommendation tracks on demand without restarting.

#### 📻 Smart Related Songs Queue
• Playing any track from **Search (`s`)** now automatically populates the **Queue (`q`)** with a curated list of related tracks and radio songs, just like YouTube Music.

#### 🌊 Animated TUI Loading & Refresh States
• Music-themed animated loader (`AnimatedLoader`) featuring animated equalizer waveform bars (` ▃▅▆▇▆▅▃ `), bouncing progress marquee, and brail

releases.title: v2.0.0 — ame rebrand
releases.body:
## ame v2.0.0

Rebranded from `ytmusic-tui` to **ame** (雨, "rain"), and removed Google
sign-in entirely.

### Rebrand
- App, launcher and repo are now `ame`; run with `./ame`.
- Class `AmeApp`, window title `ame`, theme CSS variables `$ame-*`.
- Repo moved to https://github.com/m7sh/ame (old URLs redirect).

### Removed
- All Google sign-in / OAuth / library code (`auth.py`, `ui/account.py`, the
  `g` and `6` bindings). Guest mode only — the reliable path.

### UI
- Theme-adaptive Matrix digital rain, shown only while audio is playing.
- First-letter view shortcuts (`t r m s q`); bottom key-hint bar removed.
- Terminal transparency retained (`ansi_default` backgrounds).

### Notes
- `cava` optional (visualizer); `mpv` + `yt-dlp` required.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/m7sh/ame/compare/v1.2.1...v2.0.0

releases.title: v1.2.1 — no more table scrollbar frame
releases.body:
## ytmusic-tui v1.2.1

Fixes the rectangle that appeared to surround the list. It was the DataTable's
own scrollbars, triggered by long YouTube titles making the table wider than
the window.

### Fixed
- **Scrollbars removed** from track/playlist tables and the moods list
  (`overflow-x: hidden`, zero-width scrollbars). Lists stay scrollable with
  `j`/`k`.
- **Columns now fit the window** — the title column takes the leftover width
  and `ARTIST`/`TIME` are capped, so long titles are clipped in place instead
  of pushing the other columns off-screen.
- **Resize-aware** — widths are recomputed on load and whenever the terminal
  is resized.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/m7sh/ytmusic-tui/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1

releases.title: v1.2.0 — borderless chrome
releases.body:
## ytmusic-tui v1.2.0

Removes every box/line border for a cleaner, more modern look — separation now
comes from background tone and whitespace, the way cliamp does it.

### Changed
- **Top bar** — no bottom rule; it is a one-line panel band with a blank line
  beneath it.
- **Player bar** — no top rule; separated from the content by a blank line.
- **Moods split** — the vertical divider is gone, replaced by a whitespace gutter.
- **Search** — the rounded input box is now a full-width surface band that
  highlights on focus.
- **Help overlay** — borderless, on a lighter surface so it still stands out
  over the dimmed screen.

cl iamp's text dividers (`▸─ trending ──`) and the `━` seek bar are kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/m7sh/ytmusic-tui/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0

releases.title: v1.1.0 — cliamp-inspired look + spectrum visualizer
releases.body:
## ytmusic-tui v1.1.0

A visual pass inspired by [cliamp](https://github.com/bjarneo/cliamp), plus a
real-time audio spectrum visualizer.

### Highlights
- **Letterspaced wordmark** `Y T M U S I C` and bracketed state chips.
- **Section dividers** in cliamp's style: `▸─ trending ── [2 songs] [1 chart] ──`.
- **Block volume meter** `VOL ██████░░ 80%` and a `[Q3]` queue chip in the top bar.
- **Spectrum visualizer** — [cava](https://github.com/karlstav/cava) taps the
  PipeWire monitor and drives fractional-block bars (`▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█`) with a
  green → yellow → red gradient. Hidden automatically when cava is missing.
- **Key-pill help bar** (`Esc back  Space play/pause  …`).
- **Status line**: `01:42 / 03:51  opus 160kbps  ▶ Playing` (`■ Stopped`,
  `⏸ Paused`, `◌ Buffering`), and a `STREAMING` seek bar for unknown durations.

### New bindings
- `v` show / hide the spectrum visualizer
- `h` show / hide the help bar

### Also
- Added the MIT `LICENSE` (Copyright © 2026 Mohammed Musharaf).
- New `spectrum.py` module and `Spectrum` / `SectionHeader` / `HelpBar` widgets.

### Requirements
- Python 3.11+, `mpv` and `yt-dlp` on `PATH`
- Optional: `cava` for the visualizer

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/m7sh/ytmusic-tui/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0

releases.title: v1.0.0 — Minimal terminal-native redesign
releases.body:
## ytmusic-tui v1.0.0

First tagged release. A ground-up redesign of the interface around a spare,
terminal-native aesthetic.

### Highlights
- **One screen, no clutter** — sidebar, header badges and banners are gone.
  Views switch from a single tab line or with `1`–`5`.
- **Slim two-line player** — now-playing + time, then a full-width clickable
  Unicode seek bar.
- **Help on demand** — press `?` for the keybinding overlay instead of a
  permanent cheat sheet.
- **Live Omarchy theme sync** — the Omarchy palette is registered as a native
  Textual theme with CSS variables, so switching your desktop theme restyles
  the app instantly with no flicker and no stylesheet rewrites on disk.
- **No emoji, no noisy toasts** — plain Unicode rules, block glyphs and
  reverse-style selection.

### New bindings
- `A` queue every track in the current view
- `P` play every track in the current view
- `d` remove the highlighted track from the queue
- `?` toggle the keybinding overlay

### Fixes
- `esc` in the search box now returns focus to the results instead of
  re-focusing the input.

### Requirements
- Python 3.11+, `mpv` and `yt-dlp` on `PATH`
- `pip install -r requirements.txt`

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/m7sh/ytmusic-tui/commit/bd6d3aa

releases.title: v1.2.0 — Native Dark Themes & pacman-Only Setup
releases.body:
## 🚀 v1.2.0 — Native Dark Themes & pacman-Only Setup

### 🌙 Native dark themes by default

- `prefers-color-scheme` now follows the active Omarchy theme, so sites render their own dark UI.
- Chromium's forced inversion is off by default. Its per-element colour flip was leaving switches and checkboxes half-inverted (for example, a white knob turning black while its track stayed light).
- <kbd>t</kbd><kbd>d</kbd> still toggles the CIELAB forced-dark fallback for light-only sites, live on QtWebEngine ≥ 6.7.
- The theme template and generated `theme.py` were updated to keep the scheme in sync without re-enabling inversion.

### 📦 pacman-only installation

- `qutebrowser` and `python-adblock` now come from the Arch repositories; the uv tool environment and duplicate user-site `adblock` package are gone.
- The installer fails with a clear message if either dependency is missing.
- Launcher icon lookup now searches standard `/usr/share/icons` and XDG paths instead of a hardcoded uv path.

### 🧹 Cleanup

- Removed the Greasemonkey userscript and its install/reload plumbing. YouTube is handled entirely by the Brave cosmetic injector and the in-stream skip engine.

### 🛡️ Adblock verification

A fresh-profile run across ten ad-heavy sites recorded **256 blocked requests** and **no visible ad creatives**:

| Site | Blocked | Cosmetic rules | Visible ads |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | :--- |
| Forbes | 23 | 26 hide | none |
| CNN | 34 | 22 hide + 2 style | none |
| Daily Mail | 28 | 12 hide | none |
| Weather.com | 38 | 11 hide | anti-adblock wall |
| ESPN | 16 | 2 hide | none |
| 9GAG

releases.title: v1.1.1 — Dedicated YouTube Ad Elimination & Opaque Window Fix
releases.body:
## 🛠️ Fixes in v1.1.1

### 🎬 Complete YouTube Video Ad & Banner Elimination
- **Player Response Interception**: Added `greasemonkey/youtube-adblock.user.js` which hooks `ytInitialPlayerResponse` at `document-start` to delete `adPlacements`, `playerAds`, and `adSlots` before video player initialization.
- **Fast-Forward & Auto-Skip Fallback**: Mutes and accelerates in-stream ad video elements (16×) and jumps directly to completion.
- **Cosmetic Banner Suppression**: Added comprehensive YouTube CSS to `brave_cosmetics.py` to permanently hide `ytd-ad-slot-renderer` (the sidebar ad banner in related videos), top masthead ads, and sponsor cards.

### 🪟 Removed Transparency Rules
- Set `c.window.transparent = False` in `config.py` for solid rendering.
- Removed obsolete Hyprland 0.90 window opacity rules from `hyprland.lua` and added cleanup logic to `install.sh`.

releases.title: v1.1.0 — Brave-Grade Ad Blocking & Cosmetic Filtering
releases.body:
## 🛡️ What's New in v1.1.0

### 🚀 Brave-Grade Ad Blocking Integration
This release reverse-engineers Brave Browser's adblocking architecture and integrates Brave's native `adblock-rust` engine into Qutebrowser:

- **Brave's Core Engine (`adblock-rust`)**: Leverages Brave's high-performance Rust adblock engine (via `python-adblock`) for fast network request filtering.
- **Curated 27-List Catalog (`brave-lists.txt`)**: Direct integration of Brave's default list catalog matching `list_catalog.json`:
  - uBlock Origin Filters (main + yearly archives 2020–2026, general, badware, resource-abuse, unbreak, quick-fixes, uBO link shorteners).
  - EasyList & EasyPrivacy.
  - Brave's specialized rules: `brave-unbreak.txt`, `brave-specific.txt`, `brave-social.txt`, and `brave-sugarcoat.txt`.
  - URLhaus malicious URL blocklist.
  - Cookie Notice blockers: Fanboy Cookie Monster, uBO Cookie Notices, and Brave Cookie additions.
- **Dual-Layer Defense (`content.blocking.method = "both"`)**: Combines the ABP/uBO engine with StevenBlack hosts as a secondary catch-all net.
- **Dynamic Cosmetic Filtering (`brave_cosmetics.py`)**: Restores element hiding (which stock Qutebrowser lacks) by querying `url_cosmetic_resources` and `hidden_class_id_selectors` from the live engine and injecting `<style>` sheets into web pages.
- **Pre-Compiled Adblock Cache (`build_cache.py`)**: The installer now downloads all lists and compiles `~/.local/share/qutebrowser/adblock-cache.dat` (14.6 MB) and `blocked-hosts` (2.2 MB) ahead of time for instant blocking on first run.
- **Cleaned Dependencies**: Removed red

releases.title: v1.0.0 — Live-stream-safe YouTube ad skipper
releases.body:
First tagged release of **Omarchy Qutebrowser** — an aesthetic, keyboard-driven Qutebrowser setup with dynamic Omarchy theme synchronization and Wayland transparency.

## Features

- **Dynamic Omarchy theme sync** — hooks into `omarchy theme set` and updates all Qutebrowser colors live, without closing tabs.
- **Crystal-clear 0.90 transparency** — matches `foot` / `ghostty`, with a Hyprland window rule.
- **Local terminal startpage** — fast new-tab dashboard with clock, date, DuckDuckGo search and bookmarks.
- **Vim keyboard controls** — single-key navigation, hints, tab cycling.
- **1-key MPV playback** — press `M` on any video link to stream in hardware-accelerated `mpv`.
- **Built-in YouTube ad skipping** — bundled `greasemonkey/yt-ads.js`.

## Ad skipper notes

`greasemonkey/yt-ads.js` (v1.2.0) is now **live-stream safe**:

- Detects live streams via `ytp-live`, `.ytp-live-badge`, or a non-finite `video.duration`.
- **Never seeks live streams**, so they no longer jump to the end when an ad appears.
- Still fast-forwards finite ad clips to their end.
- Uses a `MutationObserver` + polling instead of the unreliable `load` event.

> Note: live streams that use server-side ad insertion cannot be skipped by seeking — the ad plays through, but the stream is no longer broken.

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/m7sh/omarchy-qutebrowser.git /tmp/omarchy-qutebrowser && /tmp/omarchy-qutebrowser/install.sh && rm -rf /tmp/omarchy-qutebrowser
```

releases.title: v1.0.0 — Live wallpapers, silent by default
releases.body:
## Matugen Dynamic Theme v1.0.0

First tagged release of the dynamic Material You theme for **Omarchy Linux** and **Hyprland**.

### ✨ Highlights

- **Live wallpaper support** — video backgrounds (`.mp4`, `.webm`, `.m4v`, `.mov`, `.mkv`, `.avi`) now drive the palette. Matugen samples a sibling poster or a representative video frame, so live and still wallpapers produce equally accurate colors.
- **Two bundled live loops** — `samurai-over-sakura-valley-live.mp4` and `tokyo-skyline-bedroom-live.mp4`, both silent 2560×1440 H.264.
- **Silent by default** — OWE plays a video wallpaper's audio track and has no per-wallpaper mute switch, so the theme strips audio at the file level with `-c:v copy` (video stream stays bit-for-bit identical).
  - `matugen-silence` — remove audio in place or into a new file, no re-encode.
  - `matugen-add-live` — install a clip into Omarchy's user background folder, muted unless `--keep-audio`, optionally apply with `--set`.
- **Real-time watcher** — inotify-based palette regeneration on every wallpaper change, stills and videos alike.
- **Curated collection** — 7 dark anime/cyberpunk 4K stills + 2 live loops.
- **Full app coverage** — Hyprland, Quickshell, Cava, Alacritty, Kitty, Foot, Ghostty, Neovim, Helix, Btop and Obsidian.

### 📦 Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/m7sh/matugen-theme.git
cd matugen-theme
./install.sh
```

Add your own live wallpaper:

```bash
matugen-add-live --set ~/Videos/loop.mp4
```

### 🛠 Notes

- Repo live clips are 1440p to keep clones small. Installer drops them in `~/.config/omarchy/backgrounds/matugen/` an
